title: NNSA's current pit-production page characterizes U.S. capability as R&D-only and unsuitable for stockpile use
summary: NNSA's current public program page states that U.S. pit-production capability is limited to research-and-development pits unsuitable for stockpile use. Denominator: The agency's current public capability characterization, not a count of produced, qualified, rejected, reworked, accepted, or stockpile-entered pits.
